Bash: python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import json

text = ("# One\nAlpha line.\n## Two\nBeta line.\n### Three\nGamma line.\n"
        "# Four\nDelta line.\n## Five\nEpsilon line.\n")
assert text.isascii()  # file size in bytes == length in UTF-16 units

# The file's lines with their offsets, computed in jq from the fixture's text.
lines = ("def lines: " + json.dumps(text) +
         ' | split("\\n") | .[:-1]'
         ' | reduce .[] as $l ({o: 0, ls: []};'
         ' .ls += [{offset: .o, text: $l}] | .o += (($l | length) + 1))'
         ' | .ls; ')

check = {
  "format": 1,
  "rule": "req~heading-folding.unfold-all~1",
  "example": "unfolding a whole notebook",
  "files": {"notebook.md": text},
  "steps": [
    {"line": "* Given a notebook is open with every heading folded",
     "do": [{"file": "notebook.md", "as": "source"},
            {"launch": {"build": "debug", "inspector": True}},
            {"drive": ["menu", "File > Open…"]},
            {"drive": ["choose", {"file": "notebook.md"}]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"drive": ["menu", "View > Fold All"]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "folded"}],
     "expect": [
       {"that": ".folded.json.sections.notebook.length == .source.size",
        "why": "the notebook's whole text is open in the window"},
       {"that": lines + '(lines | map(select(.text | startswith("#")) | {offset, line: .text}))'
                ' == (.folded.json.sections.notebook.folded | map({offset, line}) | sort_by(.offset))',
        "why": "every heading of the notebook, nested ones included, is folded"},
       {"that": lines + '(lines | map(select(.text | startswith("#") | not) | .offset)) as $body'
                ' | [.folded.json.sections.notebook.drawn[].offset | select(IN($body[]))] == []',
        "why": "the folded headings hide the text under them"}]},
    {"line": "* When the user chooses View > Unfold All",
     "do": [{"drive": ["menu", "View > Unfold All"]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]}],
     "expect": []},
    {"line": "* Then the view shows the whole text of the file",
     "do": [{"inspect": ["state"], "as": "unfolded"}],
     "expect": [
       {"that": ".unfolded.json.sections.notebook.folded == []",
        "why": "no heading is left folded"},
       {"that": ".unfolded.json.sections.notebook.length == .source.size",
        "why": "the view holds the file's whole text"},
       {"that": lines + 'lines as $lines | .unfolded.json.sections.notebook'
                ' | .length as $n | [.drawn[] | {offset, text}] as $d'
                ' | $d == $lines or $d == $lines + [{offset: $n, text: ""}]',
        "why": "the window draws every line of the file, in order, at its offset"},
       {"that": '.unfolded.json.sections.notebook'
                ' | all(.drawn[]; .rect.height > 0) and all(.gaps[]; .height >= 0)',
        "why": "every line takes room on screen and none is drawn over another"}]}
  ]
}

with open("work/check.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(check, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    f.write("\n")

Bash: bin/palantir-accept lint work/check.json rule.md; echo "exit $?"
text=$(jq -r '.files["notebook.md"]' work/check.json; printf x); text=${text%x}
lines=$(jq -n --arg t "$text" '$t | split("\n") | .[:-1] | reduce .[] as $l ({o:0, ls:[]}; .ls += [{offset:.o, text:$l}] | .o += (($l|length)+1)) | .ls')
mk() { # $1 folded offsets json, $2 drawn offsets json
  jq -n --argjson ls "$lines" --argjson f "$1" --argjson d "$2" --argjson n "${#text}" '
    def st: {json: {sections: {notebook: {length: $n,
      folded: [$ls[] | select(.offset | IN($f[])) | {offset, line: .text}],
      drawn: [$ls[] | select(.offset | IN($d[])) | {offset, text, rect: {x:25, y:0, width:40, height:16}}],
      gaps: []}}}};
    {source: {size: $n}, folded: st, unfolded: st}'
}
heads=$(jq -c '[.[] | select(.text|startswith("#")) | .offset]' <<<"$lines")
all=$(jq -c '[.[].offset]' <<<"$lines")
echo "size ${#text} heads $heads"
run() { echo "== $1"; jq -r '.steps[] | select(.line|test("Given|Then")) as $s | $s.expect[] | .that' work/check.json | while IFS= read -r e; do jq -r "$e" <<<"$2" | tr '\n' ' '; done; echo; }
run "every heading folded, headings drawn (given: t t t)" "$(mk "$heads" "$heads")"
run "only # One folded (given 2nd false)" "$(mk '[0]' "$heads")"
run "unfolded: nothing folded, all drawn (then: t t t t)" "$(mk '[]' "$all")"
run "unfolded: # Four still folded, its body missing (then false)" "$(mk '[55]' "$(jq -c 'map(select(. != 62))' <<<"$all")")"

mk() { # $1 folded offsets, $2 drawn offsets, $3 extra trailing empty paragraph (true/false)

}
